title: display year in 'days' section of digital clock calendar
line: The clock's calendar now shows the year next to the month on the Days page too, also for the current year.
explanation: MonthViewHeader.qml showed only the month name on the Days page when the selected month was in the current year, while the Months and Years pages (and other years) showed "month year". David Edmundson confirmed it was deliberate but looks weird. The header now always uses the "Format: month year" string; the Appium digital clock test's expectation is updated to match.

commits.message:
components/calendar: always show the year in the month header

The Days page hid the year from the header when showing a month of the
current year, while the Months and Years pages always showed it, which
looked inconsistent. Now the header always reads month and year.

BUG: 518131

patches.diff:
From c771d731adaff4fc204056cf69c3f1eae5b7c2cf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 01:54:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] components/calendar: always show the year in the month header

The Days page hid the year from the header when showing a month of the
current year, while the Months and Years pages always showed it, which
looked inconsistent. Now the header always reads month and year.

BUG: 518131
---
 appiumtests/applets/digitalclocktest.py     | 8 +-------
 components/calendar/qml/MonthViewHeader.qml | 6 ++----
 2 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 11 deletions(-)

diff --git a/appiumtests/applets/digitalclocktest.py b/appiumtests/applets/digitalclocktest.py
index e356e64234..b211041c6c 100755
--- a/appiumtests/applets/digitalclocktest.py
+++ b/appiumtests/applets/digitalclocktest.py
@@ -47,13 +47,7 @@ class DigitalClockTests(PlasmaAppletTest):
 
     def compareMonthLabel(self, dateToTest):
         monthLabel = self.driver.find_element(by=AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, value="monthHeader")
-        today = date.today()
-        monthString = ""
-        if dateToTest.year == today.year:
-            monthString = dateToTest.strftime("%B")
-        else:
-            monthString = dateToTest.strftime("%B %Y")
-        return monthLabel.text == monthString
+        return monthLabel.text == dateToTest.strftime("%B %Y")
 
     def test_1_next_month(self):
         nextMonthDate = date.today() + relativedelta(months=1)
diff --git a/components/calendar/qml/MonthViewHeader.qml b/components/calendar/qml/MonthViewHeader.qml
index 14ba80d020..57a06a02a7 100644
--- a/components/calendar/qml/MonthViewHeader.qml
+++ b/components/calendar/qml/MonthViewHeader.qml
@@ -72,10 +72,8 @@ Item {
                 // Needed for Appium testing
                 objectName: "monthHeader"
 
-                text: root.swipeView.currentIndex > 0 || (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedYear !== today.getFullYear()
-                    ? i18ndc("plasmashellprivateplugin", "Format: month year", "%1 %2",
-                        (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedMonth, (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedYear.toString())
-                    : (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedMonth
+                text: i18ndc("plasmashellprivateplugin", "Format: month year", "%1 %2",
+                    (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedMonth, (root.monthViewRoot as MonthView).selectedYear.toString())
                 textFormat: Text.PlainText
                 level: root.isDigitalClock ? 1 : 2
                 elide: Text.ElideRight
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Days page for November 2026 shows just "November"
With the fix: the same view shows "November 2026"

review.text: Straightforward and clean fix in plasma-workspace that removes the current-year/Days-page special case in MonthViewHeader.qml so the calendar header consistently shows month and year across all tabs, matching maintainer confirmation on the bug. Existing i18n formatting is preserved, the Appium test expectation in digitalclocktest.py is updated to match, and the before/after screenshots confirm the result.

reviews.text: Straightforward and clean fix in plasma-workspace that removes the current-year/Days-page special case in MonthViewHeader.qml so the calendar header consistently shows month and year across all tabs, matching maintainer confirmation on the bug. Existing i18n formatting is preserved, the Appium test expectation in digitalclocktest.py is updated to match, and the before/after screenshots confirm the result.

Does exactly what the reporter asked (year on the Days page for the current year) and what David Edmundson said he would propose in c1: the header now always uses the existing 'Format: month year' string, so no new i18n strings. It is the right file in the shared calendar component, the Appium expectation is updated consistently, and the header already elides if space is short. Before/after screenshots show 'November' vs 'November 2026'; the commit message and line match the 2-file diff.
